Announcements.title: Reports, Reimagined
Announcements.message:
The Report Builder has been rebuilt from the ground up — faster to use, with more ways to slice your fleet, and a much better results experience.

**Build reports faster**
- Collapsible sections, with your active filters pinned to the top
- A new *Individual Device* scope — pull one device by serial or asset tag

**More ways to filter**
- Computer Group and Device Group filters, with a searchable list of every smart and static group
- Jamf Protect coverage (Has / Missing / Stale record) for your Macs
- All of Cleanup's stale-device filters, right in the builder

**A better results view**
- Results open in a focused window you can search across name, serial, model, OS, and more — and sort by any column
- Click any device to jump straight to its full detail

**Export that just works**
- One click to CSV, Excel, PDF, or Markdown — with your applied filters listed right in the file
- Optionally include Device Enrollment (ADE) details, including serials that are in Apple Business Manager but not yet in Jamf

**New: Environment Health Scorecard**
- A dedicated report of fleet compliance plus a managed-device breakdown by OS, exportable in every format

Open **Reports** to take it for a spin. Cleanup settings now live in **Settings → Cleanup**.
